working: Prokaryotes have 70S ribosomes made of 50S and 30S subunits, so (a) is true. Many bacteria carry plasmids, so (b) is true. Mesosomes are infoldings of the plasma membrane in prokaryotes, so (c) is true. Peroxisomes are membrane-bound organelles found only in eukaryotes, so (d) is false. The correct set is a, b and c.
